scope: Statically named Simple/Multi Counter/Gauge/Histogram declarations in inspected production sources of hoprnet, hoprd, hopr-impls, hopr-strategy and hopr-utilities. Excludes test-only instruments, dynamic/third-party/runtime families, and pending PR additions. Not a live scrape or release-availability assertion.

metrics.name: hopr_peer_count
metrics.meaning: Number of all peers

metrics.name: hopr_transport_p2p_active_connection_count
metrics.meaning: Number of currently active p2p connections as observed from libp2p events

metrics.name: hopr_transport_p2p_nat_status
metrics.meaning: Current NAT status as reported by libp2p autonat. 0=Unknown, 1=Public, 2=Private

metrics.name: hopr_network_health
metrics.meaning: Connectivity health indicator

metrics.name: hopr_session_hoprd_target_connections
metrics.meaning: Number of currently active HOPR session target connections on this Exit node

metrics.name: hopr_peers_by_quality
metrics.meaning: Distribution of the quality score of the node's directly-probed neighbors

metrics.name: hopr_strategy_enabled_strategies
metrics.meaning: List of enabled strategies

metrics.name: hoprd_http_api_call_count
metrics.meaning: Number of different REST API calls and their statuses

metrics.name: hoprd_http_api_call_timing_sec
metrics.meaning: Timing of different REST API calls in seconds

metrics.name: hoprd_http_api_last_used_time
metrics.meaning: The unix timestamp in seconds at which any API endpoint was last fetched

metrics.name: hopr_session_time_to_finish_frame
